title: Intel Stock News (Oct 16, 2026): INTC Falls 2.8% to $95.37
summary: Intel (INTC) fell 2.80% to $95.37 on Oct 15, 2026 after a fatal blast at its Kiryat Gat site and a chip selloff on hot US inflation data.
body_markdown:
The wider sector was also under pressure. As reported by[StockStory](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/formfactor-teradyne-applied-materials-amd-173627052.html) , chip shares slid after September wholesale prices rose 1.3%, a 6.3% annual gain against the 5.5% economists had expected, reviving worries that higher borrowing costs could slow AI data center spending. By the session's close, the US 10-year Treasury yield had eased 10.1 basis points to 5.09%.


A third item weighed on sentiment around Intel's foundry ambitions. Per[Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tsmc-ceo-hints-company-could-151911042.html) , TSMC CEO C.C. Wei said on TSMC's third-quarter earnings call that TSMC would support customers who chose Intel's EMIB-T packaging if they later faced supply constraints. "I try to avoid answering it directly, but let me say that, yes, we will be," Wei said.[Simply Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/intel-intc-stock-dropped-driving-191808161.html) also pointed to reported progress at Chinese rival CXMT as part of the sector's pullback.


## INTC Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said in July that EMIB-T orders were growing and that yield and reliability targets were being met, with production scaling for customers' 2027 ramps, according to Stocktwits.
- Simply Wall St noted that Intel's total shareholder return stands at 166.34% over one year, after a run tied to AI-driven revenue.
- The stock closed $5.35 above its intraday low of $90.02, recovering part of the session's deeper loss.


### Risks


- The production impact of the Kiryat Gat explosion is still undisclosed, and GuruFocus said any shipment or earnings estimate tied to it would be guesswork for now.
- Higher rates and hot inflation data could weigh on AI infrastructure orders across the chip supply chain, per StockStory.
- TSMC's offer to back up EMIB-T customers adds competitive pressure on Intel's advanced packaging business.


The next confirmed event is Intel's third-quarter 2026 results, which[the company said](https://www.intc.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1782/intel-to-report-third-quarter-2026-financial-results) it will report after the market close on Thursday, October 29, 2026.
